title: Dsat: A Native SAT Solver for Discrete Logic
abstract: arXiv:2605.09347v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Discrete variables are common in many applications, such as probabilistic reasoning, planning and explainable AI. When symbolic reasoning techniques are brought in to bear on these applications, a standard technique for handling discrete variables is to binarize them into Boolean variables to allow the use of Boolean computational machinery such as SAT solvers. This technique can face both computational and semantical challenges though. In this work, we develop a native SAT solver for discrete logic, which is a direct extension of Boolean logic in which variables can take arbitrary values. Our proposed solver has a similar design to Boolean SAT solvers, with ingredients such as unit resolution and clause learning but ones that operate natively on discrete variables. We illustrate the merits of the developed SAT solver by comparing it empirically to CSP solvers applied to discrete CNFs, to Boolean SAT solver applied to binarized CNFs,

translated_title: Dsat：一种面向离散逻辑的原生SAT求解器
translated_abstract: 离散变量在许多应用中十分常见，例如概率推理、规划以及可解释人工智能。当符号推理技术被应用于这些问题时，处理离散变量的标准做法是将其二值化为布尔变量，以便使用SAT求解器等布尔计算工具。然而，这种二值化技术在计算和语义两方面都可能面临挑战。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种面向离散逻辑的原生SAT求解器，它是布尔逻辑的直接扩展，其中的变量可以取任意值。我们提出的求解器在设计上与布尔SAT求解器类似，包含单元归结和子句学习等核心组件，但这些组件可以直接在离散变量上进行原生操作。我们通过将该SAT求解器与应用于离散CNF的CSP求解器以及应用于二值化CNF的布尔SAT求解器进行实证比较，展示了所开发求解器的优势。
tldr: 本文提出了首个面向离散逻辑的原生SAT求解器Dsat，无需将离散变量二值化为布尔变量，即可直接在多值变量上执行单元归结与子句学习，从而克服了传统二值化方法在计算和语义上的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Dsat, a native SAT solver for discrete logic that performs unit resolution and clause learning directly on multi-valued variables, eliminating the computational and semantic challenges of binarizing discrete variables into Boolean ones.
